'''Heran Adan''' is the Governor of [[Baerlon]].

==Activities==
When [[Rand]], [[Mat]] and [[Perrin]] are in Baerlon, the [[Whitecloaks]] are trying to make trouble for Governor Adan because he won't cooperate with them.
